links.outcome: Ablation of retrieval and knowledge modules on expert-rated accuracy, treatment relevance, and reliability
links.effect: Abstract reports superior accuracy, treatment relevance, and information reliability versus general-purpose models, and that ablations show each module is essential. No numbers reported in the text.
links.quote: Ablation studies highlight the essential role of each module, particularly in managing multi-modal information.

unlisted_practices: Structured medical knowledge graph reasoning (MedKG) to constrain LLM outputs
Search module for comprehensive information access
Tools module for multi-modal clinical data interpretation

screen.reason: The paper introduces a new multi-modal LLM architecture (DiagnostiCare) with modular RAG, knowledge graph, and tool components, evaluating it against a benchmark of complex medical questions.
